data.title: PR-16 fail-stop crash in the asupersync binding (path a)

data.body: [risk:high] Failure modes: a stopped task runs or cleans up, the stopped set is wrong, held work resolves instead of fencing, fences are missing or reordered, or versioned bytes gain a second meaning. Edge cases: unbegun, suspended, and sleeping tasks; nested or normally closing regions; due timers; cancellation, deadline, or channel overlap; truncated and perturbed journals. Rollback: revert ffdf3a31 before any version-3 journal persistence. If persistence is later added, retain the version-3 reader or migrate first because the base cannot read version 3. Monitoring: count CrashUnsupported, TaskCrashed, crash SubstrateRefused, lift inconclusive or violation results, fence totals, and substrate-ledger disagreement. Validation: reviewed the full persisted range 2028524e..ffdf3a31, checked the binding, decoder, lift, A7 model, and register projection, ran git diff --check, and directly ran five prebuilt suites. All 102 tests passed. No blocker found. The separate risk:critical human gate remains required.
